title: Bayesian optimization identifies a methane-combustion catalyst formula
summary: Bayesian optimization guided the experimental search over Pt/Pd and Ce/Zr ratios in PtPd@CeZrOx core–shell nanospheres. The authors report that two optimization rounds comprising 18 experiments found a formula with methane-conversion T50 approaching 330 °C, lower than prior reports cited by the study. The full assay conditions and comparison basis were not reviewed here; this is a bounded laboratory result, not a claim of general superiority, durability, or deployment.
ai_technology: Bayesian optimization for experimental catalyst-formula selection

evidence.tested: The publisher abstract reports that BO guided two experimental optimization rounds (18 experiments total) and that the selected PtPd@CeZrOx formula reached a methane-conversion T50 approaching 330 °C.
evidence.unknown: Full test conditions, exact comparator basis, replicate variability and durability were not assessed in this abstract-limited review. The reported T50 does not establish field emissions performance or general superiority.
evidence.ai_role: Bayesian optimization selected multi-component Pt/Pd and Ce/Zr catalyst-formula ratios across iterative experiments; the reported T50 is the measured outcome associated with the selected formula.

source_review.scope: Primary Wiley publisher abstract/indexed article text and PubMed primary metadata/abstract read. Full article Methods/Results and supporting information were not accessible.
